entities.summary: Avinash Mukund Sable is an Indian track athlete. He specializes in 3000 m steeplechase and holds the national record of 8:09.91, set at the 2024 Paris Diamond League. Sable has represented India in the men's 3000 m steeplechase event at the 2020 and 2024 Olympic Games. He has been honored with the Arjuna Award in 2022.
